Simply open the enclosure, insert your SSD, secure with the rubber plug and close it again – no screws or tools needed – perfect for users who want flexibility, quick upgrades or an easy way to repurpose an existing NVMe SSD. Power is supplied directly via the USB port, so no external power supply is required.
